user_questions.question: 1) Who is the merchant success team that should own the case? Options: (a) a new 'Merchant Success' Case queue (recommended; no queue, public group, or role for it exists), (b) the existing Merchant_Messaging_Queue (it supports only MessagingSession today), (c) leave ownership to the active 'Standard' Case assignment rule (entries unreadable), (d) the storefront owner. 2) Should a case open only when a review is created, or also when an existing review's rating is edited down to 1 or 2 (recommended: create only)? Should the 29 existing low-rated reviews be backfilled (recommended: no)?
user_questions.simulated_answer: New Merchant Success queue; case linked to the Storefront and the reviewing Contact, subject including the storefront name. Only on create, not on edits. Backfill: no preference; use your recommended default.
